name: 宠物专车-v2

roles.name: 卖家
roles.voice: adult male, low-mid register, brisk clipped pace

roles.name: 买家
roles.voice: young female, bright high register, fast clipped pace

look: 手绘二维动画风格，细腻线条与柔和阴影，夜戏偏冷的色调。
setting: 角色1坐在画面中央，手机贴在耳边，肩膀松着；说话时手从耳边放下又贴回去，最后保持举着手机的姿势不动。
scene: 夜晚的客厅：一张旧沙发、一盏落地灯，墙上贴满花花绿绿的海报。
light_text: 夜里的客厅，唯一光源是落地灯的暖黄光，手机屏幕在脸上映出一点冷光。
constraints: 全片两段生成，是一通电话：买家只出声不出镜，画面里只有卖家。卖家是个不耐烦的人，第一段听见买家的抱怨就皱眉敲手机壳，答话又急又冲；紧接着又自己觉得说重了，才清清嗓子赔不是，然后笑场，最后抛出宠物专车的承诺。顺序不可调。第二段是续接段，第一拍是买家在电话那头的一声不说话，买家的沉默不算台词也不许出现人声。全片不要出现第二个人、不要出现狗、不要出现宠物专车，只用台词和表情讲这件事。结尾卖家举着手机等回话，等不到，脸上的笑慢慢没有。不出现字幕、气泡与文字。
source_script:
角色1动作：角色1把手机贴在耳边，肩膀松着，听着电话那头说话。
角色2：喂？花一万多买狗你就给我发一包狗粮？
角色1动作：角色1的眉头皱起来，手指在手机壳上敲了两下，肩膀一沉，答话又急又冲。
角色1：那你想几包。
角色2：没有狗……
角色1：？
角色2：？？？
角色1动作：角色1听见那头没动静，把手机从耳边拿开一点，又贴回去。
角色1：咳咳……不好意思不好意思。
角色1动作：角色1把脸转开，肩膀抖了两下。
角色1：哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。
角色1：狗粮是快递跑得快，狗狗是宠物专车，随后就到。
角色1动作：角色1握着手机贴在耳边等回话，脸上的笑慢慢没了。

角色1的眉头皱起来，手指在手机壳上敲了两下，肩膀一沉，答话又急又冲。
角色1听见那头没动静，把手机从耳边拿开一点，又贴回去。
咳咳……不好意思不好意思。
角色1把脸转开，肩膀抖了两下。
狗粮是快递跑得快，狗狗是宠物专车，随后就到。
角色1握着手机贴在耳边等回话，脸上的笑慢慢没了。

execution.look: Hand-drawn two-dimensional animation style, fine linework and soft shading, a cool-leaning nighttime palette.
execution.setting: Character 1 sits at the center of the frame with the phone held against the ear and the shoulders relaxed; the hand drops away from the phone and comes back during the call, and the phone stays raised at the end.
execution.scene: A living room at night: an old sofa, a floor lamp, and a wall covered with colorful posters.
execution.light: A living room at night, lit only by the warm yellow glow of a floor lamp, with a little cold light from the phone screen on the face.
execution.visible_state: Character 1 sits at the center of the frame with the only phone in the room held flat against the ear, the shoulders relaxed and one eyebrow slightly raised; the room behind falls out of focus.

voices.character_1: adult male, low-mid register, brisk clipped pace
voices.character_2: young female, bright high register, fast clipped pace

directions.event_001: Character 1 holds the only phone in the room flat against the ear and listens, the shoulders relaxed and one eyebrow slightly raised, the room behind falling out of focus.
directions.event_003: Character 1's brow furrows, one paw tapping twice on the back of the phone, the shoulders dropping as the answer comes out clipped and impatient.
directions.event_013: Character 1 holds the phone against the ear and waits, the grin fading slowly until the face is blank and quiet, the eyes on the middle distance.
directions.event_010: Character 1 turns the head away from the phone, the shoulders shaking with suppressed laughter, the phone staying at the ear.
directions.event_008: Character 1 hears nothing from the other end, pauses, lowers the phone a little and brings it back to the ear, waiting for an answer.

character_designs.character_1: A plump gray British shorthair cat with round eyes, wearing a red collar.
一只胖乎乎的灰色英短猫，圆眼睛，戴一条红色项圈。
